description: Is this software version still supported? End-of-life status from endoflife.date for 400+ products (languages, frameworks, databases, OSes, runtimes, cloud services): status (supported, security-only, eol, unmaintained), release, active-support and EOL dates, days until/since EOL, LTS flag, latest patch for the cycle and whether you are on it, the recommended upgrade cycle, and plain advice. Fuzzy product matching with suggestions; batch up to 10 product@version items. Price: $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/eol-check

items.description: Batch alternative: comma list of product@version, up to 10 (python@3.8,nodejs@18)

product.description: Product name or endoflife.date slug (python, nodejs, django, postgresql, ubuntu, ...)

version.description: Version or release cycle (3.8, 3.8.10, 18, 22.04); omit for all current cycles
